name: Loomwell
category: Apparel — everyday and casual wear, men's and women's
market: India, metros and tier-1/2, online-first with a growing own-store footprint
master_idea: Clothes that earn their place in the wardrobe
positioning: Fewer, better everyday clothes for people who dress for their own day
tone: Plain, confident, unfashiony — no hype, no trend-chasing
notes: Seasonal category with festive and wedding peaks. Online returns run 25-40% and are the single biggest economic issue — fit and colour accuracy matter more than reach. Discounting is structural in the channel, so full-price sell-through is the real measure.
avoid: never imply a garment is a season-only purchase
